result: Adding a small perturbation and a gradient shift (run SVRG on f − ⟨∇f(x̃), x − x̃⟩ during a super epoch) makes plain SVRG find ε-second-order stationary points with Õ(n^{2/3}/ε² + n/ε^{1.5}) stochastic gradients, almost its first-order cost and without a negative-curvature subroutine.
result_plain: Stabilized SVRG: perturbation + gradient shift give second-order guarantees at Õ(n^2/3/ε² + n/ε^1.5).
